mainEntity.name: What are the steps involved in the permit coordination process?

acceptedAnswer.text: The permit coordination workflow begins with assembling construction drawings, architectural plans, and engineering reports. Next, we submit the application packet to the appropriate building authority and track its progress through planning, zoning, environmental, and structural reviews. If the plan examiner issues corrections, we work directly with the design team to revise and resubmit drawings promptly. Once the permit is approved and issued, construction begins, and we manage the schedule of mandatory field inspections through the final certificate of occupancy.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process covers gathering plans, submitting application packets, resolving municipal plan-check corrections, securing the permit, and scheduling mandatory field inspections.
